title: NodeCatalog spec (kind schema, WS-01)
description: Validates the `spec` of a NodeCatalog registry document, published by replicant-worker CI (C-DEF 2.1.0 publish source `worker_ci`) once per build ID. The C-DEF envelope already constrains workerDeployment and the minimum node fields; this schema adds the fields the registry, graph compiler, bundle builder, and tightening checker (WS-06 ADR-001, XD-06-01) rely on.

patchOf.description: Emergency patch builds only (versioning.md section 7): the build ID whose live histories this build was replay-verified against.

engine.description: Graph engine compiled into this build (temporal-langgraph.md section 3).

carrySchemas.description: Continue-As-New carry schemas this build can read (it writes the last one). Migration eligibility requires the source job's carry schema to be listed here.

migrationProtocol.description: Migration Handoff Protocol version implemented (versioning.md section 6). Frozen: every build implements v1.

effectClass.description: XD-06-01. check_only: may fail the job or raise risk; never writes the workspace or calls an external side effect. workspace_write: produces a diff (AgentRun with a writable workspace). external_side_effect: anything visible outside the replicant (GitHub, Slack, memory candidates).

protected.description: Core role: cannot be removed, retyped, or skipped by graph modifiers; cannot carry a `when` guard (human_gate: only additive).

bounded.description: Loops through this node are bounded by the node itself (repair budget, expiry), satisfying invariant I-4.

interrupts.description: May pause the graph (LangGraph interrupt). Never allowed inside a parallel branch.

effects.description: Effect names this node type uses in logical activity IDs.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the node's exports (visible to guards as nodes['<key>'].*).
